criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: Inversion ('biggest AI story...wasn't AI') is specific and stake-bearing, well inside the 210-char cutoff; third sentence names zero deployment as the concrete stake. Docked from 10 because no named deadline/contract appears in the first two lines (AFCEC date is para 4).

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.notes: Every paragraph carries an AK anchor plus a named industry consequence (BEAD milestone risk, LEO connectivity gap, defense demand signal, workforce risk, ANC workforce). Minor: DAF para is intentionally brief background.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named execs, dated events, precise numbers, contract number, named installations in nearly every sentence; all softening notes applied. Marginally below 10 for omitting per-line veto figures.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Every claim traces to a verified source; all softening honored. E2 and A1 high confidence; E1/E3 medium and dual-sourced with primary URLs dead this cycle (E1 leans on secondary aggregators).

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, position-taking, no banned phrases, no emojis, no we/us. Standout structural lines. Marginal deduction for 'The pattern is plain' edging toward newsletter cadence.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Eight tight paragraphs, in-range word count, well under 3000 chars, easy to scan. Minor: dense three-option closing sentence.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Genuine, debatable, three-way question tied to the central tension; no CTA. Minor: comma-delimited options can read dense on mobile.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Three distinct revisit triggers: AFCEC-26-R-0006 closes June 29, ACS CEO effective Sept 1, FY2027 veto effective July 1.

hard_fail_checks.name: punctuation_bans_held
hard_fail_checks.detail: No em/en-dash, double-hyphen, colon, or semicolon in body; single hyphens in compounds only.

hard_fail_checks.name: word_count_in_range
hard_fail_checks.detail: Body word count in the 350-475 window (orchestrator count 423, scorer count 454; both in range).

one_sentence_fix: Optional polish: move the AFCEC-26-R-0006 June 29 close date into the first two lines so the hook carries both the inversion and a named, imminent deadline.
